article.title: Future與InfoSum合作，擬把媒體受眾訊號接入WPP規劃工具
article.title_en: Future and InfoSum partner to bring publisher audience signals into WPP planning
article.summary: 兩家公司將連接Aperture與InfoSum，讓媒體規劃人員在現有流程使用出版商的第一方資料。
article.summary_en: The partners will connect Aperture and InfoSum so planners can use publisher first-party data in existing workflows.
highlights: WPP Media規劃人員將可在Open Intelligence使用相關訊號。
Future稱系統可配對品牌與出版商各自收集的資料。
highlights_en: WPP Media planners are set to get the signals in Open Intelligence.
Future says the integration supports matching brand and publisher first-party data.
article.why: 媒體團隊可評估出版商的內容互動訊號，能否補足品牌既有的受眾名單。
article.why_en: Publisher content engagement may fill gaps in an advertiser’s existing audience lists.
article.next_step: 請代理商列明可用市場、配對條件與受眾規模，再決定是否試投。
article.next_step_en: Ask the agency to confirm markets, matching requirements and audience sizes before a trial.
article.detail: Aperture利用Future旗下媒體的內容互動建立受眾分類。接入InfoSum後，規劃人員可按公告所述把這些分類用於媒體方案。品牌在比較這類資料時，宜把配對規模、實際可投放人數及投放後的增量分開記錄。公告未列出香港帳戶的開放日期，能否使用需按市場和代理商安排確認。
article.detail_en: Aperture groups audiences using engagement across Future’s media properties. The integration is intended to bring those groups into media planning. Track matching scale, reachable audience and campaign lift separately. The release gives no Hong Kong access date.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
